summary.intent: Continue the release-notes work for the callisto repo: after opening the changelog title fix PR (#550), move on to the open npm gap by fixing `pnpm.overrides` handling so it follows a version bump.
summary.outcome: PR #550 (changelog title fix, linked to trail #250) was opened and awaits approval and CI. A new branch off origin/main got a `pnpm.overrides` fix in `npm.rs` with a test and a changeset. Tests, clippy, fmt and the comment check passed, and it was committed and pushed, with the trail #179 link and PR still to do.

repo: PRs are created through the Entire CLI, which links the branch to a trail (e.g. #250, #179) and opens the PR; merging and approval happen in Entire.
Changes need a `.changeset/*.md` file (e.g. `pnpm-overrides-follow-a-bump.md`) alongside the code.
The standard pre-commit gate is the crate tests plus clippy, fmt and a repo comment check; all must exit 0.
Work is done in the worktree `.claude/worktrees/quality-sweeps`, with fix branches cut from origin/main.
The changelog logic treats a leading foreign title (e.g. `# Changelog`) like an ecosystem prefix and replaces it with the package title, keeping front matter on top.

code.finding: Holds the pnpm override handling. It was edited so `pnpm.overrides` entries follow a version bump, with a new free function and imports added.
Existing override tests live here; the new pnpm overrides test was added next to them.

workflow: Report unverified conclusions honestly: the intermittent failure was labelled a likely pre-existing flake, with CI named as the real check.
Branch each fix separately off origin/main so PRs stay independent (#549, #550, and the overrides fix).
Run the narrow test targets plus lint before committing.

friction: The full `callisto-graph` test suite exited 101 five times when run right after other cargo commands. The failing test was never identified, and later reruns and individual targets passed.
The stale remote branch `origin/fix/version-lock-refresh-rollback` still needs cleanup.
open_items: Approve and merge #549 (pyproject crash fix) and #550 (changelog title fix) in Entire, and check CI on #550.
Decide whether npm should also error when a root-level pin goes stale; only `pnpm.overrides` is being fixed.
Link the overrides fix branch to trail #179 and open its PR through Entire.
Find the cause of the intermittent `callisto-graph` full-suite exit 101.
Report the sweep results for the fix branch (run `43788922941`) when the user asks.
